description: Australian Irrigation Areas (Vector), Version 1A, National Land and Water Resources Audit is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences. This data set shows designated and actual irrigation areas in Australia compiled by the National Land Use Mapping Project of the National Land and Water Resources Audit to assist in the identification of irrigation areas in Australia. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences. Its tags are administrativeboundaries, agriculture, boundaries, culturalboundaries, environment. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, shp, txt, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
